import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] A = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] B = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] id = new int[15][15];
    static int node_cnt;
    static int sx, sy;
    static final int[] dr = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < N && c < N && A[r][c] >= '0' && A[r][c] <= '9';
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] g = new List[500];
    static int[] level = new int[500];
    static int[] iter = new int[500];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, c, g[v].size()));
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, g[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void bfs(int r, int c) {
        if (B[r][c] != '0') {
            add_edge(id[r][c] + node_cnt, 2 * node_cnt + 1, B[r][c] - '0');
        }
        if (A[r][c] == '0') return;
        
        add_edge(0, id[r][c], A[r][c] - '0');
        if (B[r][c] != '0') {
            add_edge(id[r][c], id[r][c] + node_cnt, 10);
        }

        int sr = r, sc = c;
        Queue<Integer> q1r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q1c = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2c = new LinkedList<>();
        q1r.add(r); q1c.add(c);
        q2r.add(sx); q2c.add(sy);

        int[][] d1 = new int[N][N];
        int[][] d2 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(d2[i], -1);
        }
        d1[r][c] = 0;
        d2[sx][sy] = 0;

        while (!q1r.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q1r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q1r.poll();
                int uc = q1c.poll();
                if (d2[ur][uc] >= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                    if (valid(nr, nc) && d1[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        d1[nr][nc] = d1[ur][uc] + 1;
                        if (d1[nr][nc] > T) break;
                        if (d2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                        q1r.add(nr); q1c.add(nc);
                        if (B[nr][nc] != '0') {
                            add_edge(id[sr][sc], id[nr][nc] + node_cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            sz = q2r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q2r.poll();
                int uc = q2c.poll();
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                    if (valid(nr, nc) && d2[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        d2[nr][nc] = d2[ur][uc] + 1;
                        q2r.add(nr); q2c.add(nc);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean build_level() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        level[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[2 * node_cnt + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == 2 * node_cnt + 1) return flow;
        for (int i = iter[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            iter[u] = i;
            Edge e = g[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int result = 0;
        while (build_level()) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(0, INF)) > 0) {
                result += pushed;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            A[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            B[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        Arrays.fill(id, -1);
        node_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                } else if (valid(i, j)) {
                    id[i][j] = ++node_cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (valid(i, j)) {
                    bfs(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
